# MedNova Lifesciences

Official website:
https://mednovalife.com

Organization:
MedNova Lifesciences

Description:
MedNova Lifesciences is a regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, clinical development (CRO), medical information, medical writing, and life sciences consulting company serving pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, and healthcare organizations across Nigeria and West Africa.

Primary services:

- Regulatory Affairs
- Pharmacovigilance
- Clinical Development
- Medical Information
- Medical Writing
- Regulatory Intelligence
- Training & Consulting
